image_description: A close-up, eye-level photograph of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, showing the broad, reddish-brown carapace and the two large chelipeds (claws) resting in front. The eyes are visible on stalks at the front margin of the shell. The lighting is warm, highlighting the glossy texture of the exoskeleton and the cream-colored tips of the claws.
